name: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI)
description: A 19-item self-report questionnaire measuring sleep quality and disturbances over the past month across seven component scores: subjective quality, latency, duration, efficiency, disturbances, medication use, and daytime dysfunction.
reputation: Most widely used sleep quality measure in research; free public domain; cutoff >5 indicates poor sleeper.
notes: Self-report; retrospective recall over past month; cultural norms may vary.
